Name: Mrrmarash
Description: Recommended Level: 4-7 Description: The verdant marsh lands surrounding lake Ancahato are filled with all manner of dangerous swamp creatures, dangerouser swamp plants, and Kobalds. It's a great location for aspiring alchemists to venture for their initial experiments, provided they can survive, as useful materials are abundant and high quality. Enemies: Venus Mancatcher, Poison Ivy, Kobald, Giant Mosquito, Crocodile Herbs: Chalkadonny, Silverfrond, Marshweed Ores: Iron, Cobalt Chemicals: Morte Gas, Silverwater, Peat
